# Epigram

> Open-Source, Free, and AI-Powered News in Short.

Epigram is an open-source, AI-powered news application built for busy people. It
delivers quick, clear summaries from reliable sources so readers get the news
without the overwhelm, with deeper analysis and topic feeds tailored to their
interests.

Live site: https://epigram.news
Source code: https://github.com/panda-sandeep/epigram

## Features

- Personalized news feed: a curated feed based on the topics you follow.
- AI-powered summaries: concise news summaries generated by Exa, plus
  in-depth analysis generated with the AI SDK and OpenAI.
- Trusted sources: access to news from reputable sources worldwide via the
  Mediastack news data API.
- AI deep dive: in-depth analysis of individual news articles using AI.
- User-friendly interface: a sleek, intuitive, responsive design with support
  for adding the app to the home screen on Safari.
- Keyword search and related-article retrieval powered by Exa.

## Tech Stack

- Next.js (App Router) and React for the web application.
- Tailwind CSS for styling.
- AI SDK with OpenAI for summaries and analysis.
- Exa for AI-powered news search and content retrieval.
- Mediastack for news data.
- Upstash Redis for caching and rate limiting.
- Google Cloud Run for serverless deployment.

## Project Structure

- `src/app` — application routes, including the home feed, topics, about page,
  and API routes under `src/app/api/news`.
- `src/components` — React UI components.
- `src/modules` — integrations with Exa, Redis, and shared utilities.
- `src/types` — shared TypeScript types.
- `public` — static assets such as icons, the manifest, and images.

## API Routes

- `GET /api/news` — returns the news feed, optionally filtered by the
  `categories` query parameter.
- `GET /api/news/populate` — cron-triggered endpoint that fetches fresh news
  from Mediastack; protected by a secret header.
- `POST /api/news/ai-insights` — generates AI insights for a given article.
- `GET /api/news/ai-insights/sources` — lists available insight sources.

## Environment Variables

The application is configured with the following environment variables:

- `MEDIASTACK_API_KEY` — Mediastack news data API key (required).
- `EXA_API_KEY` — Exa API key (required).
- `OPENAI_API_KEY` — OpenAI API key (required).
- `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` — Upstash Redis REST URL (required).
- `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN` — Upstash Redis REST token (required).
- `EPIGRAM_CRON_SECRET` — secret used to authenticate the populate cron
  endpoint (required).
- `BASE_URL` — base URL of the deployment (sample value in `.env.example`:
  http://localhost:3000).
- `EPIGRAM_SECRET_HEADER_NAME` — name of the secret header for the cron
  endpoint (sample value in `.env.example`: X-Epigram-Secret).
- `PER_TOPIC_NEWS_LIMIT` — number of articles fetched per topic (sample value
  in `.env.example`: 5).
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID` — optional Google Analytics ID.
